proof_body:
by
  intro a b ha hb hab hlen
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range a) :=
    ⟨b 0, by
      rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact (hab n).trans (hb (Nat.zero_le n))⟩
  have hax : Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds (⨆ n, a n)) := tendsto_atTop_ciSup ha hbdd
  have hbx : Filter.Tendsto b Filter.atTop (nhds (⨆ n, a n)) := by
    have h := hlen.add hax
    simpa using h
  refine ⟨⨆ n, a n, fun n => ⟨le_ciSup hbdd n, hb.le_of_tendsto hbx n⟩, fun y hy => ?_, hax, hbx⟩
  exact le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto' hbx fun n => (hy n).2) (le_of_tendsto' hax fun n => (hy n).1)
target_source: ∀ a b : ℕ → ℝ, Monotone a → Antitone b → (∀ n, a n ≤ b n) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => b n - a n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → ∃ x : ℝ, (∀ n, a n ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b n) ∧ (∀ y : ℝ, (∀ n, a n ≤ y ∧ y ≤ b n) → y = x) ∧ Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds x) ∧ Filter.Tendsto b Filter.atTop (nhds x)
